Title: [Eligibility]&[Reshop]&[Reprice]&[Exchange][Response] Verify the four V2 Reissue endpoints (Eligibility, Reshop, Reprice, Exchange) are deployed on the target host and answer for the target supplier.
Capabilities / Test Data: Endpoints from the Re-Issue collection, folder 5. Reissue: POST {{baseUrl}}api/v2/Reissue/Eligibility, /Reshop, /Reprice, /Exchange. There is no Reissue Lookup endpoint; the collection looks the booking up with V2 FlightBooking/Retrieve. One ticketed PNR from TC-RI-CAP-03 (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken). Reissue suppliers today: OmanAirV17, AegeanV21, Ajet (SPEC §2.16); run the suite once per supplier with that supplier's own routes (supplier-only scope).
Preconditions: Target host, supplier and selector confirmed (collection environment: stg-ne-2, OmanAirV17, EGY). Staging only.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. POST Eligibility with supplier, credentialsSelector, pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken. 2. POST Reshop with the same booking keys, one searchCriteria entry (new date D+28) and the booked passenger types/counts. 3. POST Reprice with a well-formed but unknown responseId/selectedOfferId. 4. POST Exchange with a well-formed but unknown responseId/selectedOfferId. 5. Record status, body, response time.
Expected Result: No call returns 404, 405 or 409 OperationNotSupported. Eligibility returns HTTP 200 with a boolean isChangeable. Reshop returns HTTP 200 (offers[] or an explicit no-availability result). Reprice and Exchange reject the unknown ids with a 4xx error in the standard envelope (Q20), not 404/405/5xx. Nothing is reissued.
SpecReference: AC-05; AC-07; AN#13, #18, #19; Q1, Q2; Coll: Postman_Collection/Re-Issue, folder 5. Reissue; SPEC §2.16
Notes: Type: Functional | Technique: EP | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection. Suite entry gate. If it fails, mark every Reissue row BLOCKED for this host. Exchange only receives unknown ids, so no ticket changes.
